title: The Death of the Author Revisited
text:
Literary critics have long debated whether a text's meaning resides in the author's intention or in the reader's interpretation. Structuralist theorists, by contrast, argued that meaning emerges from the system of relations among signs rather than from any individual mind. Roland Barthes went further, proclaiming the 'death of the author' and inviting readers to become the true producers of a text.

Yet this position has not gone unchallenged. Critics of reader-response theory warn that unlimited interpretation risks dissolving any stable criteria for judging a reading as more or less valid. Many contemporary scholars therefore seek a middle path, acknowledging the reader's creative role while still insisting that the text itself constrains what can plausibly be claimed.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what did structuralist theorists argue?
options: Meaning comes from relations among signs rather than from an individual mind.
Meaning is fixed by the author's biography.
Texts have no meaning at all.

questions.text: What do critics of reader-response theory warn about in the second paragraph?
options: Unlimited interpretation may remove stable criteria for judging readings.
Readers are too rarely creative in their responses.
Authors refuse to publish their work.
Texts are usually too short to interpret.

questions.text: Which conclusion about the debate is best supported by the passage?
options: A consensus has been reached and reader-response theory has been abandoned.
The question of meaning remains contested, and some scholars seek a balance between author and reader.
Authors have no role at all in literary study.
Structuralism has been proven correct beyond dispute.

questions.text: The phrase 'death of the author' most likely suggests that Barthes
options: wanted authors to stop writing altogether.
believed the author's intention no longer settles what a text means.
thought authors died before finishing their work.
argued that author biographies should be banned from schools.

paragraph_translations: Літературні критики давно сперечаються про те, чи значення тексту міститься в намірі автора, чи в інтерпретації читача. Структуралістські теоретики, навпаки, стверджували, що значення виникає із системи зв'язків між знаками, а не з окремого розуму. Роланд Барт пішов далі, проголосивши «смерть автора» і закликавши читачів стати справжніми творцями тексту.

Однак ця позиція зустріла не лише підтримку. Критики теорії рецептивної естетики попереджають, що необмежена інтерпретація ризикує розчинити будь-які стабільні критерії для оцінки того, наскільки прочитання є обґрунтованим. Тому багато сучасних науковців шукають середній шлях, визнаючи творчу роль читача і водночас наполягаючи на тому, що сам текст обмежує те, що можна правдоподібно стверджувати.
